title: 5x Iced Flavours Fantasi | 50/50 Bundle
description:
Fantasi Ice 50/50 Shortfill E-Liquid Bundle:
Our hugely popular Fantasi Ice Bundle just got a whole lot smoother with our 50/50 mix.
Now you can vape your favorite Fantasi Ice flavors in your starter kit, vape pen or POD system!
50/50 e-liquids are made with 50% VG (Vegetable Glycerin) and 50% PG (Propylene Glycol), which make them ideal for the lower powered vape devices.
Cola Ice – like a can of ice cold pop right out of the fridge!
Orange Ice – enjoy the taste of sweet and juicy ice cold orange soda any time you like!
Grape Ice – supremely cooling and mouth-wateringly fruity!
Mango Ice – Fresh, exotic, and super chilled ripe mangoes!
Lemonade Ice  – real lemonade flavour, supercooled for the ultimate polar rush!
Ingredients:
Vegetable Glycerine (50%)
Propylene Glycol (50%)
Vapoholic Flavouring
Nicotine Free, Freebase Nicotine, Or Nicotine Salts
What’s in The Bundle?
1x Cola Ice Shortfill
1x Orange Ice Shortfill
1x Grape Ice Shortfill
1x Mango Ice Shortfill
Nic Shots or Nic Salt Shots
Specifications:
Ratio
50/50
Size
100ml, 120ml
Nicotine Strength
3mg, 6mg
Flavor
Citrus, Cola, Drinks, Fruit, Grape, Ice Cool, Lemonade, Mango, Orange, Tropical
Highlights:
5 of our best-selling Fantasi iced flavor’s!
Available with nic salts, freebase, or keep nicotine-free
Perfect for pod kits, vape pens, and starter kit
Delicious flavors in a perfectly balanced ratio!
